summary.en: While on the way to dinner, Conan and the group come across a bunch of people dressed as Kamen Yaiba fans. They are invited to the party where an attempted murder and suicide appears to occur, but Conan begins to wonder if there is more than meets the eye to this. Injury: Gunshot wound Culprit: Katsuji Mishima Mishima fired at Honda with his gun, but Honda was wearing a bullet proof vest which is why he didn't get killed. Victim: Katsuji Mishima Cause of death: Gunshot wound on Right temple Suspects: Yasuyuki Tsutsumi, Madoka Saotome, and Osamu Honda After Mishima fired at Honda with his gun, he raises the gun to his head and pulls the trigger. Could this really be a suicide?
